newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BSE to launch spread and basket deals on Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: BSE to launch spread and basket deals on Dec 2.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange will introduce BUX index and discount Treasury bill spread deals and currency basket deals in its futures section on December 2, the Hungarian MTI news agency said on Tuesday.
If the market of spreads -- linked buying and selling deals -- becomes active, the BSE will add Budapest Interbank Offered Rate (BUBOR) spreads, MTI said, quoting an unnamed BSE official.

Currency basket straddles, to be launched on the BSE on December 2, will include two foreign exchange futures -- both selling or both buying -- deals for the same delivery date, reflecting the composition of the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) currency basket, MTI said.
The NBH basket, against which Hungary's forint floats, is made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu. The Ecu will be replaced with the mark from January 1.
BSE officials were not available for comment.
